import os
import re
from datetime import datetime, date
from openpyxl import load_workbook

input_path = "/mnt/data/spreadsheet/30709/1_30709_input.xlsx"
output_path = "/mnt/data/outputs/30709_0_7f9bb2e9/1_30709_output.xlsx"

wb = load_workbook(input_path)
ws = wb["Sheet1"]

def parse_date_from_text(value):
    if value is None:
        return None

    if isinstance(value, datetime):
        return value
    if isinstance(value, date):
        return datetime(value.year, value.month, value.day)

    text = str(value)

    patterns = [
        # dd.mm.yy, dd-mm-yyyy, dd/mm/yyyy
        (r'(?<!\d)(\d{1,2})[.\-/](\d{1,2})[.\-/](\d{2,4})(?!\d)', "dmy"),
        # yyyy.mm.dd, yyyy-mm-dd, yyyy/mm/dd
        (r'(?<!\d)(\d{4})[.\-/](\d{1,2})[.\-/](\d{1,2})(?!\d)', "ymd"),
    ]

    for pattern, order in patterns:
        m = re.search(pattern, text)
        if not m:
            continue

        a, b, c = [int(x) for x in m.groups()]

        if order == "dmy":
            day, month, year = a, b, c
        else:
            year, month, day = a, b, c

        if year < 100:
            year += 2000 if year <= 69 else 1900

        try:
            return datetime(year, month, day)
        except ValueError:
            pass

    return None

# Cell-level answer range: E6:E19.  Compute each result from the corresponding D cell.
for row in range(6, 20):
    result = parse_date_from_text(ws.cell(row=row, column=4).value)
    out_cell = ws.cell(row=row, column=5)
    out_cell.value = result
    if result is not None:
        out_cell.number_format = "yyyy-mm-dd"

os.makedirs(os.path.dirname(output_path), exist_ok=True)
wb.save(output_path)
